input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After 神农 sees the sick people, add his concern: “神农看见他们生病了，心里很着急。”
2. At the end, add a short inner question to show his purpose: “神农想：‘这些植物到底能不能吃呢？’”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting feeling after Shen Nong sees people become ill.
The learner already says that Shen Nong wants to know which plants can and cannot be eaten.
